dct:provenance: Authoritative discovery began at https://www.alliancegenome.org/downloads on 2026-07-27. The live JavaScript application reported Alliance release 9.0.0 through https://www.alliancegenome.org/api/releaseInfo and populated the Downloads page from https://fms.alliancegenome.org/api/datafile/by/release/9.0.0?latest=true. All 104 files for the exact data-type and subtype branches rendered by that Downloads UI were downloaded from their FMS stableURL values and represented in distribution. The Downloads UI requested INTERACTION-GEN/XBXT, but the release API returned no matching file, so that unavailable branch cannot be represented. The FMS API returned 419 internal release records; records not selected by the public Downloads UI (including ingest inputs, superseded assembly variants, and non-displayed subtypes) were not treated as public Downloads-page holdings. All public files are single gzip-compressed files, not multi-member archives; therefore no archive inner-file FileObjects were added. JSON and presentation-oriented TXT files remain fully represented in distribution, but RecordSets were not generated for them because reliable row/value extraction paths could not be established from a five-line sample without inventing mappings. No coherent geographic hierarchy was present: Expression Location is an anatomy/expression-site value and variant chromosome positions are genomic rather than geographic, so no GeoCoordinates field was added. description: The Alliance of Genome Resources (the Alliance) is a knowledgebase for the domains of genetics and genomics in the discipline of comparative biology. The primary mission of the Alliance is to develop and maintain a knowledge commons platform for comparative genomics that facilitates the use of diverse model organisms to investigate the genetic and genomic basis of human biology, health, and disease. At the heart of our mission lies our commitment to ensuring long-term preservation and accessibility to the expertly curated and standardized annotations representing functional, phenotypic, and disease association properties of genes and other genome features diligently provided by Alliance members.
